Sunny: Capital is available and financing conditions are supportive. The weekly guidance sets the tempo inside that window. The priority this week is to scale the highest-ROI bets, hire deliberately, and keep payback discipline. The scores are clear of the change lines. Conditions change if: Funding pressure rises 70 pts from 0 to clear 70, or risk appetite falls 5 pts from 55 to 50 or below. A score is sitting near the line where conditions change, so check again before expanding any commitment.

---
WHETHER · Weekly operating guidance

Updated Jan 8, 2021

---

MARKET CLIMATE

✅ Sunny: Money is cheap and available.

Capital is accessible and financing conditions are supportive.
Expect faster approvals and higher tolerance for bold bets.


Contextual, not moral: this is what the environment is rewarding right now.


---

RECOMMENDED MOVES FOR PRODUCT TEAMS (NOW)

• Prioritize speed and distribution over perfection
• Scale proven growth channels and widen market coverage
• Move decisively while enforcing payback guardrails


---

EXECUTION PRIORITIES THAT TRAVEL WELL

• Growth experiments with clear scaling paths
• New market expansion backed by demand signals
• Product investments that amplify acquisition


---

WATCHOUTS THAT BREAK EXECUTION

• Over-optimizing cost at the expense of momentum
• Delaying launches while waiting for perfect data
• Under-investing in capacity while demand is strong


---

PLANNING LANGUAGE TO USE

> “Move quickly on growth bets, maintain payback discipline, and set clear exit criteria before scaling spend.”



---

EXECUTION CONSTRAINTS

• Prioritize reach and learning velocity over perfect finish.
• Spend with clear guardrails, even if some experiments fail.
• Scale capacity ahead of demand only where leading signals stay strong.


---

MARGIN

Margin: clear of the line
Uncertainty: this is an interpretive read, not a forecast. Check the assumptions against your own numbers before you act on it.


---

Freezing: Capital is expensive and lenders are pulling back. Prioritize survival over growth. The priority this week is to freeze discretionary scope, protect runway, and require proof before new bets. A score is within reach of its change line. Conditions change if: Funding pressure falls 10 pts from 80 to 70 or below, or risk appetite rises 35 pts from 15 to clear 50.

---
WHETHER · Weekly operating guidance

Updated Sep 16, 2022

---

MARKET CLIMATE

⚠️ Freezing: Money is expensive and hard to raise.

Capital is expensive and risk tolerance is down.
Assume slower approvals, tighter scrutiny, and low patience for long-horizon bets.


Contextual, not moral: this is what the environment is rewarding right now.


---

RECOMMENDED MOVES FOR PRODUCT TEAMS (NOW)

• Anchor the roadmap to runway protection and near-term ROI
• Cut bets that depend on external sentiment improving
• Use reversible releases and staged commitments by default


---

EXECUTION PRIORITIES THAT TRAVEL WELL

• Retention, expansion, and monetization for existing users
• Reliability, trust, and cost-to-serve improvements
• Features with payback in under 6 months


---

WATCHOUTS THAT BREAK EXECUTION

• Adding headcount before revenue is committed
• Starting long-horizon platform rewrites
• Running experiments that weaken short-term cash flow


---

PLANNING LANGUAGE TO USE

> “Prioritize short-payback, reversible work and stop new bets that raise burn or depend on a rebound in risk appetite.”



---

EXECUTION CONSTRAINTS

• Shorten payback windows and preserve cash.
• Delay speculative hiring or large platform rewrites.
• Route roadmap bets through revenue certainty.


---

MARGIN

Margin: within reach of the line
Uncertainty: this is an interpretive read, not a forecast. Check the assumptions against your own numbers before you act on it.


---

Freezing: Capital is expensive and lenders are pulling back. Prioritize survival over growth. The priority this week is to freeze discretionary scope, protect runway, and require proof before new bets. The scores are clear of the change lines. Conditions change if: Funding pressure falls 30 pts from 100 to 70 or below, or risk appetite rises 49 pts from 1 to clear 50.

---
WHETHER · Weekly operating guidance

Updated Jun 23, 2023

---

MARKET CLIMATE

⚠️ Freezing: Money is expensive and hard to raise.

Capital is expensive and risk tolerance is down.
Assume slower approvals, tighter scrutiny, and low patience for long-horizon bets.


Contextual, not moral: this is what the environment is rewarding right now.


---

RECOMMENDED MOVES FOR PRODUCT TEAMS (NOW)

• Anchor the roadmap to runway protection and near-term ROI
• Cut bets that depend on external sentiment improving
• Use reversible releases and staged commitments by default


---

EXECUTION PRIORITIES THAT TRAVEL WELL

• Retention, expansion, and monetization for existing users
• Reliability, trust, and cost-to-serve improvements
• Features with payback in under 6 months


---

WATCHOUTS THAT BREAK EXECUTION

• Adding headcount before revenue is committed
• Starting long-horizon platform rewrites
• Running experiments that weaken short-term cash flow


---

PLANNING LANGUAGE TO USE

> “Prioritize short-payback, reversible work and stop new bets that raise burn or depend on a rebound in risk appetite.”



---

EXECUTION CONSTRAINTS

• Shorten payback windows and preserve cash.
• Delay speculative hiring or large platform rewrites.
• Route roadmap bets through revenue certainty.


---

MARGIN

Margin: clear of the line
Uncertainty: this is an interpretive read, not a forecast. Check the assumptions against your own numbers before you act on it.


---
